## 🌳 SharedTree DDS Changes

### Reduce repeated schema processing in SharedTree ([#28530](https://github.com/microsoft/FluidFramework/issues/28530))

SharedTree reuses schema analysis and view-schema definitions across overlapping and recursive schemas, reducing repeated work during view configuration, context creation, index setup, and schema export.

Schema definitions without reachable staged upgrades can also share conversions across upgrade policies.

Definition map iteration order may change but remains unspecified. Schema hashes and persisted schema encoding are unchanged.

These changes can reduce startup time and memory use for applications with large schemas.

#### Change details

Commit: [`4890b80`](https://github.com/microsoft/FluidFramework/commit/4890b806f9b61176f7d52f29a8b900ac7f49dc9e)

Affected packages:

- @fluidframework/tree
- fluid-framework

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

### Cancel pending flush requests promptly when the connection disconnects ([#28623](https://github.com/microsoft/FluidFramework/issues/28623))

Pending flush requests now reject with the connection's disconnect error when the connection is disposed or disconnected. This prevents summary uploads waiting on a flush response from remaining pending after disconnection.

#### Change details

Commit: [`a7801b2`](https://github.com/microsoft/FluidFramework/commit/a7801b2c836ac2a9aa0e6ca6279422265a0f4aea)

Affected packages:

- @fluidframework/odsp-driver

## Legacy API Changes

### New containers can be created in a OneDrive or SharePoint folder identified by its item ID ([#28634](https://github.com/microsoft/FluidFramework/issues/28634))

The new `createOdspCreateContainerRequestFromOptions` function takes an `OdspCreateContainerRequestOptions` object, which identifies the folder for the new file by either its path (`filePath`) or its item ID (`parentFolderId`). Unlike a folder's path, its item ID doesn't change when the folder is renamed or moved.

```typescript
import { createOdspCreateContainerRequestFromOptions } from "@fluidframework/odsp-driver/legacy";

const request = createOdspCreateContainerRequestFromOptions({
  siteUrl,
  driveId,
  parentFolderId, // The folder's item ID, not its path
  fileName: "Notes.fluid",
});
await container.attach(request);
```

The existing [`createOdspCreateContainerRequest`](https://fluidframework.com/docs/api/odsp-driver/#createodspcreatecontainerrequest-function) function, which takes a folder path, is unchanged.

#### Change details

Commit: [`0fe597f`](https://github.com/microsoft/FluidFramework/commit/0fe597f852e23c7541a9e650adfe2b4d952aeb71)

Affected packages:

- @fluidframework/odsp-driver
